scenario_title: Online checkout funnel for a regional grocery retailer, Jan-Mar 2024
data_context: The e-commerce team logged every session step for the first quarter of 2024 while a redesigned cart page was rolled out, to see where shoppers stop.
script:
dim("stage", ["Landing", "Product", "Cart", "Checkout", "Purchase"],
    weights=[0.34, 0.26, 0.18, 0.13, 0.09], ordered="stage", group="funnel")
dim("channel", ["Search", "Social", "Email", "Direct"],
    weights=[0.40, 0.25, 0.20, 0.15], group="acquisition")
dim("device", ["Desktop", "Mobile", "Tablet"],
    weights=[0.45, 0.45, 0.10], group="acquisition")

time("event_date", start="2024-01-01", end="2024-03-31", freq="daily")

measure("basket_value",
        "lognormal(mu = 3.2 + 0.3*[stage=Checkout] + 0.5*[stage=Purchase], sigma = 0.4)",
        unit="USD", additive=True)
measure("dwell_seconds",
        "gamma(shape = 2.0, scale = 18 + 12*[stage=Product] + 20*[stage=Checkout])",
        unit="seconds", additive=True)
measure("bounce_rate",
        "clip(0.62 - 0.09*[stage=Cart] - 0.18*[stage=Checkout] - 0.30*[stage=Purchase] + gaussian(0, 0.05), 0, 1)",
        unit="rate", additive=False)

emit(1400)

intents.sentence: Where shoppers drop out along the checkout path
How basket value splits across acquisition channels
How dwell time is spread within each stage
